sentences.text: The Buff-tailed Bumblebee has been reported in Mainz-Bingen mainly from February to September, peaking in June and July.
It has been recorded visiting the flowers of Greater Knapweed, Creeping Thistle, and White Clover.
It has also been recorded visiting the flowers of Heather, Oregano, field scabious, Himalayan balsam, and common dandelion.
